newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips sees chip plant outside Netherlands.
newsitem.headline: Philips sees chip plant outside Netherlands.

text.p: Philips Electronics NV said on Tuesday its next semi-conductor fabrication facility was almost certain to be built outside the Netherlands, despite recent speculation to the contrary.
A Philips spokesman said the company's Nijmegen plant in the Netherlands was already the largest computer chip facility in Europe and Philips did not want built its next plant in the same country.
"Although a decision has not been taken, it's almost certain that our next fabrication facility will not be built in the Netherlands," he told Reuters.
"The search continues. We are looking (at sites) in Europe, Asia and America," he added.
The company has estimated the cost of a new plant at $1 billion.
